Aditya / team — I reviewed Globex's PDF redlines and flagged the priority negotiation items below. Comments inline in the attached draft. High-level: 

1) Data transfers / lawful basis — Globex asked for the EU-US Addendum; acceptable but we should push to keep SCCs + standard DP Annex language. If they insist on Addendum, confirm they will sign our version of the addendum (I will propose a narrow EU-US Addendum that mirrors our SCC commitments).

2) Subprocessor carve-outs — they requested contract-level indemnity for downstream subproc failures. We should decline broad indemnities; suggest liability cap carveout only for breaches caused by Redwood's negligence.

3) Audit rights / accreditation — request to narrow to SOC 2 Type II and on-demand security questionnaire responses; avoid full onsite audits.

4) Retention / deletion scope — Globex redlined almost all deletion windows to 30 days. For certain data categories (model telemetry), we need 90 days to retain for quality and billing reconciliations. Propose a middle ground (45 days) and an exceptions table.

I'll prepare redline responses for Kimberly to review.

Neha Kapoor
Senior Privacy Counsel, Redwood Inference

Laura — thanks for your patience. Attached and linked below is Redwood's response to your redlines with inline commentary (highlights: transfers, subprocessors, retention). Key points: 

- Transfer mechanism: we are happy to sign the EU SCCs; Kimberly will include the standard SCC language as an addendum. If Globex prefers the EU-US Addendum, we can accept but need to use our redlined version (Kimberly attached).
- Subprocessors: confirmed APAC infra entries on your XLSX — we will provide 30-day notice for new additions and commit to a monthly published subprocessor register.
- Retention: proposing 60 days for telemetry and 30 days for customer PII unless otherwise specified in the SOW.
- Audits: SOC 2 Type II + shared questionnaire is acceptable; decline onsite audits.

Execution plan: Kimberly will send a DocuSign envelope to Globex Legal with: (1) Final DP Annex (incorporating agreed redlines), (2) SCC addendum (if requested), (3) Subprocessor register snapshot.
